gaps.lead: I can't wait for the holidays to start.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: the 'to' is a preposition.

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: The company has a good reputation in the local area.
gaps.sentence: The company ___ of in the local area.
gaps.explanation: 'People speak highly of it' becomes the passive 'it is highly spoken of'.

gaps.lead: Despite his serious injury, he finished the marathon.
Jogging every morning was completely normal for him.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be accustomed to.
